scope: Chunking and retrieval for bilingual undergraduate computer science course RAG
repository_version_note: Repository and documentation URLs were read as live pages; no commit-pinned implementation was installed or reproduced.

sources.title: Is Semantic Chunking Worth the Computational Cost?
sources.venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: NAACL 2025
sources.relevance: Retain fixed and recursive chunking as cost-aware baselines.
sources.limit: Inconsistent benefits in evaluated settings do not prove semantic chunking never helps.

sources.title: Chunking Methods on Retrieval-Augmented Generation – Effectiveness Evaluation Against Computational Cost and Limitations
sources.relevance: Compare reliability and runtime as well as retrieval and generation quality.
sources.limit: Failed configurations were excluded downstream; success-only averages cannot establish an overall winner.

sources.title: Evaluating Chunking Strategies for Retrieval-Augmented Generation on Academic Texts
sources.relevance: Structured academic documents are a closer analogue to course material than generic web snippets.
sources.limit: Evaluated cluster chunking did not beat simpler baselines; small local models and MiniLM differ from this project's Qwen setup.

sources.title: Structure-Aware Semantic Chunking with Title-Chain Prefixes: A 1600-Query Evaluation and the Measurement Trap in Text-Transform Ablations
sources.relevance: Motivates a separate title-prefix ablation and stable relevance labels across text transformations.
sources.limit: Private corpus, combined interventions, two LLM annotators rather than two humans, and unstable judge agreement; not strong isolated causal evidence.

sources.title: Docling HybridChunker
sources.relevance: Hierarchical structure, tokenizer-aware refinement, context serialization and table header repetition.
sources.limit: Implementation reference, not a demonstrated course retrieval improvement; parser and tokenizer compatibility need evaluation.

sources.title: LlamaIndex Auto Merging Retriever
sources.relevance: Index leaves, store parent text, and merge retrieved evidence into larger original contexts.
sources.limit: Illustrative example with historical model settings, not a bilingual course benchmark; expansion must obey an independent context budget.

sources.title: Late Chunking: Contextual Chunk Embeddings Using Long-Context Embedding Models
sources.relevance: Contextualize token representations before pooling into chunk vectors.
sources.limit: Needs compatible token-level outputs and pooling; the current pooled-vector remote adapter cannot provide these. Distinct from ColBERT late interaction.

sources.title: Introducing Contextual Retrieval
sources.relevance: Index-time chunk context can feed both dense and lexical retrieval.
sources.limit: Reported relative top-20 failure reduction includes multiple components and is not a 67-point recall gain; extra indexing and reranking costs.

sources.title: Qwen3 Embedding and Reranker
sources.relevance: Test retrieval-task query instructions and dedicated multilingual rerankers with the current embedding baseline.
sources.limit: Historical leaderboard claims are dated; local course gains and rerank endpoint availability have not been established.

sources.title: jina-reranker-v3.5: Faster Listwise Reranking with Hybrid Attention and Self-Distillation
sources.relevance: Recent compact multilingual listwise reranking candidate for a shared-candidate comparison.
sources.limit: Author top-100 candidate protocol; BEIR and MIRACL winners differ. Speed comparison uses A100 and Jina v3, not our API or CPU.

sources.title: DenseOn with the LateOn: Fully Open Dense and Late-Interaction Models for Multilingual, Long-Context, and Code Search
sources.relevance: Open multilingual multi-vector alternative, with 307M mLateOn and reproducible training/evaluation resources.
sources.limit: Needs new encoder and index; Chinese is not one of the eight translate-train target languages; author tables do not establish superiority to this project's Qwen 8B.

sources.title: NextPlaid
sources.relevance: Serving option for multi-vector retrieval with quantization, incremental updates and metadata filtering.
sources.limit: Model export and runtime compatibility need verification; published serving hardware differs from this local environment.
